description: Runner online-detection convergence: heartbeat-driven runnerId→connectionId map, plus runner-client dispatch-connection self-check with proactive reconnect and immediate post-reconnect heartbeat

tasks.title: Server: heartbeat-driven map convergence + Ping probe target
tasks.description: Add an optional `ConnectionId` field to `RunnerHeartbeatRequest`. Inject the existing `RunnerConnectionTracker` singleton into the `/api/runner/{runnerId}/heartbeat` handler and call `Register(runnerId, connectionId)` when the field is present and non-empty — never call `Unregister` from the heartbeat path. Add a `Ping()` hub method on `RunnerHub` returning `Context.ConnectionId` as the liveness-probe target for the runner client.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/runner/{id}/heartbeat with body {"connectionId":"C"} results in tracker.GetConnectionId(id) == "C"
POST /api/runner/{id}/heartbeat with empty body or absent connectionId leaves any existing tracker entry for that runner unchanged
POST /api/runner/{id}/heartbeat with {"connectionId":""} or null leaves any existing tracker entry unchanged (heartbeat never erases)
After a simulated SignalR OnDisconnectedAsync erases the entry, the next heartbeat carrying a connection id repopulates it
The /heartbeat handler never calls RunnerConnectionTracker.Unregister
SignalR invocation of "Ping" on /hubs/runner returns the caller's connection id
Unit/integration tests cover every case above
Existing RunnerStatusApiSpecs and orphaned-task-recovery specs still pass unchanged
Server build passes under TreatWarningsAsErrors
tasks.output: Heartbeat endpoint refreshes the runner connection map from an optional connectionId field; RunnerHub.Ping available as a probe target

ConnectionId = null; /heartbeat handler at line 40 — inject RunnerConnectionTracker and call Register when ConnectionId is non-empty), packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Runner/Services/SignalR/RunnerHub.cs (add Ping method). RunnerConnectionTracker.Register semantics already overwrite; no tracker change needed. Tracker is registered as a singleton in MohistServiceRegistration.cs:153.

tasks.title: Runner client: carry connectionId in heartbeat, self-check dispatch liveness, proactive reconnect with immediate heartbeat
tasks.description: Add an optional `connectionId?: string | null` field to `RunnerRegistration` (core/types.ts). `RunnerHost.registrationState()` populates it from `this.signalR.getConnectionId()`. Since master commit `4b784e443` already wired `ServerConnection.heartbeat(state, signal)` to spread `...state` into the POST body, the connectionId flows through with zero signature change to `heartbeat()`. Expose `getConnectionId()`, `probeLiveness()` (invoke "Ping" with a bounded timeout), and `forceReconnect()` (stop() then start()) on `RunnerSignalRClient`. Register `HubConnection.onreconnected` so both auto-reconnect and manual `forceReconnect` funnel through one host callback (`onDispatchReconnected`) that re-calls `connection.heartbeat(this.registrationState(), signal)` immediately. Add a self-check timer in `RunnerHost.run` on `DISPATCH_LIVENESS_PROBE_INTERVAL_MS` (default 10000) that probes and calls `forceReconnect` on failure. Add the option to `RunnerOptions` and wire it in `cli.ts`.
acceptanceCriteria: RunnerRegistration has an optional connectionId field; registrationState() populates it from signalR.getConnectionId() so heartbeat() sends it as a JSON field via ...state spread
RunnerRegistration.connectionId is null/undefined before the SignalR connection starts, so no connectionId is sent in that window
RunnerSignalRClient.getConnectionId returns the current HubConnection.connectionId (null before start)
RunnerSignalRClient.probeLiveness returns true on a successful Ping invoke within the timeout, false on rejection or timeout
On probe failure with connection.state === Connected, forceReconnect calls stop() then start() and the connection re-emerges with a new connectionId

After any successful (re)connect — manual forceReconnect OR signalr auto-reconnect — connection.heartbeat is invoked exactly once with the new connection id (read via registrationState()) before the next heartbeat-cycle tick
RunnerHost.run starts a self-check timer on DISPATCH_LIVENESS_PROBE_INTERVAL_MS (default 10000) alongside the existing heartbeat timer; the heartbeat interval and liveness timeout are unchanged
The self-check timer is cleared in the same cleanup path as the heartbeat timer (no leak across reconnect loops)
RunnerOptions has dispatchLivenessProbeIntervalMs; cli.ts reads DISPATCH_LIVENESS_PROBE_INTERVAL_MS (default 10000)
Unit tests cover probe success, probe failure, the forceReconnect path, and the onreconnected → immediate-heartbeat callback
Runner typecheck (npm run typecheck -w packages/runner) and tests (npm test -w packages/runner) pass
tasks.output: Runner heartbeats carry the dispatch connection id; the client self-probes /hubs/runner liveness, proactively reconnects on dead-socket detection, and refreshes the server map within seconds of reconnect
tasks.notes: Files: packages/runner/src/core/types.ts (add connectionId?: string | null to RunnerRegistration; add dispatchLivenessProbeIntervalMs to RunnerOptions), packages/runner/src/server/connection.ts (no signature change — heartbeat already spreads ...state per commit 4b784e443; connectionId flows through automatically), packages/runner/src/server/runner-signalr.ts (add getConnectionId/probeLiveness/forceReconnect/onreconnected wiring; existing withAutomaticReconnect stays), packages/runner/src/runtime/host.ts (registrationState() at line 233 adds connectionId: this.signalR.getConnectionId(); run() at line 60 adds self-check timer + onDispatchReconnected callback that calls connection.heartbeat(registrationState(), signal); clear self-check timer in the finally block at line 71 alongside clearInterval(heartbeat)), packages/runner/src/cli.ts (read DISPATCH_LIVENESS_PROBE_INTERVAL_MS, default 10000, into RunnerOptions.dispatchLivenessProbeIntervalMs). Probe timeout suggested 5s. Ping target is added in T-001.
